title: 4chan whistleblower: fewer bodies found in crashed craft
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of 4chan whistleblower: fewer bodies found in crashed craft, about late 1990s-2000s (posted early 2023) at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um and so now he's like we see he's like we see a lot less bodies in these crafts.

plain: Chris Ramsay, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, retells what an anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board, wrote in early 2023 about working on crashed craft. According to Ramsay, the poster said they now find far fewer bodies inside the crashed craft than before, which would hint that whatever flies them has changed.
